title: Cards and photos: distance only when known, credits on the photo, a readable corner icon, stock photos not repeated, public places say who runs them
why: Jason's screenshots of Parks & Landmarks and a memorial's page (approved 2026-11-22, handoffs/screens-proposal-2026-11-22.md A4-A6, A13, B3). A card shows a distance only when it says something: a park placed only by its town showed '0 mi'. Each photo's credit moves from a line under every card onto the photo itself, with an i (Jason 2026-11-17: credit on the photo with an i). The icon in a card's corner sits on a dark disc, so it reads on a pale sky. The same stock photo never shows twice in one list (the pattern instead), and memorials and monuments never get a stock photo (their own, Commons, else the pattern; decisions/0143's order otherwise kept). A public place (an agency's park or memorial) shows who runs it, from its Nexus, never 'Unclaimed' (decisions/0070's claim-kinds note). No outside calls, no cost.
